text: okay I was so tired today and baby was cluster feeding all night bleeding seems to be lighter but my boobs are rock hard and sore and mostly I felt really teary around lunch for no reason but my mom came over to hold him
I'm exhausted, up every two hours, but we got outside for ten minutes and that helped.
I can't do this anymore lol the baby has been up since 4am, sending coffee.
Had a good cry in the car after the pediatrician, then felt better. I think I just needed it.
My heart melted when she smiled today.
Got out of breath chasing the toddler around the yard, I'm so out of shape, we laughed about it.
Stairs are hard with the c-section still healing but it hurts less than last week.
Cramping a little while nursing, same as yesterday, bleeding is mostly brown now.
I feel overwhelmed by the laundry and the visitors and just want a nap.
I worry a lot about whether he's eating enough.
Feet are still a little puffy at the end of the day but better than the first week.
Felt a bit lightheaded when I got up too fast, ate lunch, and it went away.
Had a small headache after not drinking enough water. It went away after a glass and a nap.
Night sweats again and my shirt was soaked, and also I leaked through my nursing pads.
Feeling kind of down today, I miss my old routine.
